dataset_title: Weighted Stock Price Index Historical Data (TAIEX)
catalog_agency: Securities and Futures Bureau, Financial Supervisory Commission, Executive Yuan, R.O.C.
license_note: Requires attribution; compatible with Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (section 4.2).
transformations: Convert ROC calendar year to Gregorian by adding 1911
missing_day_policy: Show only source trading sessions. No invented or zero-filled records.
limitations: The source endpoint is a rolling current-month snapshot; use the stored file for reproducibility.
OHLC summarizes extremes and endpoints but does not reveal intraday event order or a complete volatility estimate.
attribution: Taiwan Stock Exchange / Securities and Futures Bureau, 2026. Weighted Stock Price Index Historical Data. Open Government Data License 1.0. https://data.gov.tw/en/datasets/11755; https://data.gov.tw/license. Adaptation: date and numeric-type normalization and 1–16 October 2026 selection.
